name: Mimi planted-foot bilateral leg sway
limits: Body control drives both independent legwear meshes in the same screen direction. Knee-in remains a separate field and can be combined for review.
At body ±100 the thigh/knee field reaches at most 10 native pixels. The field tapers to zero by y1010; footwear is not deformed, and ankle/sole geometry remains fixed.
motion_v80 is rejected because it translated the feet; this candidate returns to the v79 base and corrects motion ownership. User visual acceptance pending.
